This document lists 
minor maintenance procedure P1, which must be performed after five years as 
indicated by Y5 in the above title block.

The first 
draft initiated & tested at 22 Jan 2004 by eng Abdel Rahman Hassan Abdel Rahman 
Seiody at Cairo North 220kv substation, accepted by eng Ahmed Shelaby Faisal 
General Director, and approved by eng Samir Saleh; EHV Network Head Sector Cairo 
zone EETCo.

items:
A work permit must be issued, 
the qualified maintenance staff should
 carry the suitable safety category,

Wear your safety helmet, 
 safety shoes .... etc
Switch off the circuit breaker.
Ensure that the operating mechanism has been secured against unintentional movement

Ensure that the control voltage supply lines have been disconnected and 
correctly earthed.

If the operating mechanism has been removed from the circuit breaker, do not 
perform any manipulations on the operating mechanism if the spring assembly is 
completely or only partially charged.
Safety helmet & safety shoes

Portable air blower,
 torque wrenches with extension spec.
Torque screw driver with extension spec.

Filter's Hammer,
 Cotter pin driver
Benzing assembly tool.
SF6 gas detector.

rows: * Hexagon pin with Hexagon wrench opening/length

items:
Carry out the annual procedures stated in the MPIS 
 document no. CB-110-r0

Thoroughly 
 inspect the part and, if necessary, replace it, it is not necessary to replace 
 the part if it shows no wear or only slight wear on the endangered areas or 
 the silver coating is not damaged.
The operating mechanism has been secured against unintentional movement.
The control voltage supply lines have been disconnected and correctly earthed.

If the operating mechanism has been removed from the circuit breaker, do not 
perform any manipulations on the operating mechanism if the spring assembly is 
completely or only partially charged.

By turning the selector knob 13205
 (Figure 3/1 a), 
 relieve the spring assembly such that the last switching 
 operation to be carried out is an opening one.

Initial position: operating 
 mechanism in "OPEN"
 position.

Using the selector knob 13205 switch the breaker to 
 "CLOSE"
 position.

Fully charge the spring assembly manually and then 
 switch again to "OPEN" and "CLOSE" by means of 
 the selector knob. The springs are then positioned as shown in
 Figure 7/3 a.

Now place a block of wood 
 measuring 20x50x150 mm on the spring plate 13302 and then switch to 
 "OPEN" for the last time. The spring plate 13302 must rest on the block of 
 wood. The spring assembly is then not fully relieved but is blocked (Figure 
 7/3 b)

Initial position: operating 
 mechanism in "CLOSED"
 position

Using the selector knob 13205 switch 
 to "OPEN" and "CLOSE". The springs are then 
 positioned as shown in
 Figure 7/3 a. Proceed as above described.

Detach pull rod 10731 from lever 13120 by with drawing 
 the spiral pin 10739 from bolt 10735. Remove the bolt and replace the spiral 
 pin.

Remove the operating mechanism by detaching the screw 
 connections 10007/10008/10009. Replace lock washer 10007.
Lift off the operating mechanism.
Reassembly in reverse order.

sections.text:
After completion of the necessary preparations, checks are carried out 
according to the above procedures as follows:

items:
Cheese-head screw 13069 (Figure 
 7/4b) for securing the cam 
 disc 13060 to actuating shaft 13600.

Hexagon screw 13059 (Figure 
 7/4a) or securing the cover disc 
 13051 and bearing cover 13605 to casing of operating mechanism 13010.

Cheese-head screw 10009
 Figure 7/4b for securing the 
 casing of operating mechanism 13010 to casing 10700 of the extinction unit.

Locknut 13706 (Figure 
 7/4c) for securing the lock 13700 to 
 the casing of the operating mechanism 13010.
Check cable connections for contact.
Tighten all loose connections.

Disconnect the power leads to the rewind motor 13401 
 from the limit switches 13431/13432.

Disconnect screw connections 13407 / 13408 / 13409, 
 replace spring rings 13407, and washers 13408.

Pull remind motor 13401 with pinned freewheel clutch 13410 from eccentric 
 shaft 13470.

Remove and replace spiral brace 13419, then pull
 clutch coupling 13411 off transmission shaft and replace.

Fit freewheel clutch 13410 on to transmission shaft and 
 pin.
Fit rewind motor 13401 on to eccentric shaft 13470
Secure rewind motor with screw connection 13407/13408/13409.
Check that the freewheel clutch 13410 function correctly.
Disassemble remind motor as above described.

Disconnect screw connections 13487/13489 and remove, 
 and replace spring washers 13487.
Pull bearing bracket 13481 off eccentric shaft 13470.

Detach the roller chain 13464 from sprocket wheel lift 
 13475.
Lift out eccentric shaft 13470 and replace.

Replace the roller chain 13464 onto sprocket wheel lift 
 13475 and ensure that the parts are fitted in the correct position. 
 Figure 
 7/5c.

Maneuvers the eccentric shaft into the correct bearing 
 position in the housing.

Fit bearing bracket 13481 onto eccentric shaft and 
 secure with screw connection 13487/13489.

Tighten screw connection only slightly, as the bearing 
 bracket must be able to move.

Push eccentric shaft in the direction of the arrow. 
 Figure 7/5c
Adjust the necessary play by shifting the bearing bracket & then tighten.
Open locking device of ball socket 13286.
Dismantle circlip 13284, remove plain washer 13287, replace both washers.

Pull ball socket off spherical gudgeon (Figure 3/1a) respect. 13941 
 (Figure 7/5i) and remove rod 13280 
 respect. 13281
Measure length L1 respect L2 of rod 13281 respect 13280.
Disassemble ball socket and replace.

Readjust to previously measured lengths L2
 respect. L1 
 by turning adjusting nuts 13285 (Figure 7/5h), Lock ball socket 13286 
 and adjusting nuts 13285 with hexagon nuts 13288/13286.
Refit rod 13281 respect.13280.
Re-close locking device of ball socket 13286.
Fit pin washer and refit circlip.

Open locking device of ball socket 13286 
 on spherical gudgeon 13943.
Pull ball socket off spherical gudgeon.
Detach spherical gudgeon 139.47/13948/13949 2*).

Detach screw connections 13407/13408/13409,
 2*) Replace spring washers 13947 and plan washer 13948.
Replace driver 13940 and tripping rod 13950.
Secure driver 13940 with screw connection 13947/13948/13949 2*).
Refit spherical gudgeon 13941 and spring ring 13943 2*).
Insert tripping rod and check for free free movement.

Check play S1 
 according to Figure 7/5 e and if necessary, readjust by turning the guide bolt 
 13961, then lock with counter nuts.

Detach both cylindrical traction springs 
 13725 from carrier 13701 of lock 13700 and replace.

Fit traction springs first to both 13729 
 and then hook into carrier. For mounting position refer to 
 Figure 7/5 g

Relieve spring assembly 
 as already described in Relieving the 
 Spring Assembly

Detach end link with spring catch "B" of 
 roller chain 13301 from chain cam plate 13610.

Lift chain holder 13303 out of spring 
 plate 13302.

Detach end link with spring catch "B" from 
 chain holder. Replace roller chain 13301.
Reinstall in reverse order.

Relieve spring assembly as already 
 described in 
 Relieving the 
 Spring Assembly
Drive out spiral brace 13129 and replace.

Withdraw bolt 13125 from housing cpl.13010 
 .This releases lever cpl. 13120 and washers 13128. replace lever cpl., bolt 
 and washers.
Reinstall in reverse order.

Adjust cam roller 13123 to position of cam 
 disc 13060 with washers 13128.

Open locking devices of ball socket 13286 
 of the tripping rod 13950 on spherical gudgeon 13941. Pull ball socket off 
 spherical gudgeon.

Open spring catch "B" on roller chain 13301 
 on the side of the chain cam plate 13610.

Unscrew screw connection 13057/13059. 
 Replace spring ring 13057.

Shift actuating shaft 13600 some mm (a 
 fraction of an inch) to the right and lift the shaft out of the casing of the 
 operating mechanism 13010.
Reassemble in reverse order.

Lubricate according to
 Figure 7/2a, b, c.

Relieve spring assembly as already 
 described in
 Relieving the 
 Spring Assembly

Unscrew screw connection 
 13067/13068/13069. Replace spring ring 13067.
Pull of cam disc 13060 and replace.
Reassemble in reverse order.

Check play; adjust with spacer (strip 
 disc) 13065 to 0.3 mm (=0.012 in )( fig 7/6c).

Drive out spiral brace 10739 at either 
 end. Replace washers 10738.
Remove bolts10735 at either end.
Remove and replace pull rod 10731.
Reassemble in reverse order.

Disassemble shaft of the operating 
 mechanism as already described in Replacing the 
 Reserve Parts

Unscrew locknut 13706. Replace this and 
 spring washers 13707.

Disassemble and replace locking device 
 13700 cpl.

Replug buffer 13705 into new locking 
 device.
Reassemble in reverse order.

Disconnect plug contacts "P" of electrical 
 connections.

Unscrew screw connections 
 14016/14017/14019.
Pull off and replace coil 14011/14012.
Reassemble screw connection.

Check dimension "s"; values in table of 
 legend to Figure 7/7a, b, c. System de-energized, coil and armature separated to 
 maximum spacing.
Plug in electrical connections again.

Disconnect plug contacts "P" of electrical 
 connections.

Unscrew screw connections 
 13506/13508/13509 and disassemble guard plate 13522.
Remove bolt 13533.
Withdraw lever 13512.

Disassemble auxiliary switch 13500 
 and replace. (for mounting position see
 Figure 7/7c)

Remount auxiliary switch; install lever, 
 bolt, and guard plate.
Plug in electrical connections again.
Measure the timing test (open - close) cycle
Measure the contact resistance.
